# PerformanceMidiLoader { #timetoalign.loader.midi.performance.PerformanceMidiLoader }

```python
loader.midi.performance.PerformanceMidiLoader(
    parse_durations=True,
    on0_means_off=True,
    include_controls=True,
    include_program_changes=True,
    unit=None,
    number_type=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Load performance MIDI files using mido.

This loader parses raw MIDI messages, preserving the performance characteristics
(timing, velocity, control changes) without attempting structural analysis.

It pairs note_on/note_off events into Note intervals and stores control
changes as Instant events.

### from_file { #timetoalign.loader.midi.performance.PerformanceMidiLoader.from_file }

```python
loader.midi.performance.PerformanceMidiLoader.from_file(
    path,
    *,
    parse_durations=True,
    on0_means_off=True,
    include_controls=True,
    include_program_changes=True,
)
```

Create a loader and load a MIDI file in one step.

Convenience constructor for loading a single file.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                    | Type                                   | Description                                 | Default    |
|-------------------------|----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|------------|
| path                    | [Path](`pathlib.Path`) \| [str](`str`) | Path to the MIDI file.                      | _required_ |
| parse_durations         | [bool](`bool`)                         | Whether to pair note_on/off into intervals. | `True`     |
| on0_means_off           | [bool](`bool`)                         | Treat note_on with velocity 0 as note_off.  | `True`     |
| include_controls        | [bool](`bool`)                         | Include Control Change events.              | `True`     |
| include_program_changes | [bool](`bool`)                         | Include Program Change events.              | `True`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                      | Description                                                        |
|--------|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'PerformanceMidiLoader\' | A new PerformanceMidiLoader instance with the file already loaded. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> loader = PerformanceMidiLoader.from_file("performance.mid")
>>> loader.ticks_per_beat
480
```
